dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Model optimisation sample includes 87 datasets; appendix lists public datasets (ABCD, ABIDE, ABIDE II, ADHD200, Cam-CAN, HCP Aging/Adult Brain/Development, Healthy Brain Network/CMI, UK BIOBANK) and ENIGMA-associated datasets such as GSP, MCIC, Rockland (NKI), and ADNIGO (ADNI); HCP-EP used for psychosis analysis.
